recentItems.title: DEVIL LIVED Tamil Short Film | Vimal Palaniyandi | Tamil Shortcut | Silly Monks
recentItems.description:
Watch the World's First semordnilap screenplay - DEVIL LIVED Tamil Short Film.

Synopsis: 
Devil Lived is a political-psychological short film structured around a powerful semordnilap, a word that reveals a different meaning when read in reverse. Just like history. Just like ideology. The Short film unfolds over a single night where a woman named Bharathi is being chased by a man named Gandhi. Here, the word “DEVIL” becomes metaphor. Read one way, it suggests devil. Reversed, it suggests something that lived. The film draws a parallel to Mahatma Gandhi, a figure simultaneously deified and demonized, a man interpreted differently depending on where one stands in history. Devil Lived metaphorically examines how British's divide and rule fractured the nation, how perspective reshapes truth, and how history written forward is often understood backward. In a country born from both non-violence and bloodshed, the film leaves the audience with a lingering question: from which side do we choose to see Gandhi?

Star Cast: Vijayalakshmi Veeramani, Karthick Raj, Muhilan, Dhinesh, Marain, Sarabesh
